context_in: TEMPUS ADVENTUS › II. Post diem 16 decembris › In Officio dominicali et feriali, a die 17 usque ad I Vesperas Nativitatis exclusive › AD TERTIAM complete on p. 12; next AD SEXTAM
context_out: End of TEMPUS ADVENTUS (section II, ADV-II). AD NONAM: Ternis horarum terminis (H.IV) complete on p. 13 (doxology + Amen). Nothing follows. p. 14 opens TEMPUS NATIVITATIS I, usque ad sollemnitatem Epiphaniae, AD VESPERAS (Christe redemptor omnium, H.I), a new section.
flags: Last page of Advent section; no other rubric or chant follows Nonam. p. 14 starts TEMPUS NATIVITATIS.
Rows on ADV-II wkday null per section rule (same as pp. 11-12).
